jan-hussing.name: Jan A. Hussing
jan-hussing.tag: Connecting German industrial leadership to MEA's sovereign and political decision-making landscape.
jan-hussing.bio:
Jan A. Hussing is the founder and president of the German World Club and CEO of the German Emirates Club.

He spent his childhood in Hamburg, Germany and following his studies in economics, held board member positions e.g. at DaimlerChrysler and ING, in Germany, England, the USA, and South Africa.

In the fall of 2005, he relocated to Dubai and initially served as a member of the board of directors at Dubai Islamic Bank, responsible for the automotive division and its subsidiaries.

In the following years he embarked on an entrepreneurial path, founding companies in the automotive, service and entertainment industries. 

With over 20 years of expertise in the MEA region, he leverages a broad and trusted network of entrepreneurs, investors and top-tier decision-makers in both the institutional and corporate sectors across Europe and the Middle East, offering exceptional market understanding and strategic expertise.
exp: Geopolitical risk assessment across MEA jurisdictions
Sovereign wealth and governmental investment strategies
Policy frameworks and regulatory navigation
Germany–MEA bilateral economic relations
Strategic advisory at government-to-business level
jan-hussing.bg: With extensive experience advising senior executives and institutional investors on MEA market entry and expansion, Jan translates complex geopolitical developments into actionable intelligence for Club members.

dr-ricco-deutscher.name: Dr. Ricco Deutscher
dr-ricco-deutscher.tag: Navigating sovereign capital flows and institutional investment frameworks across the MEA region.
dr-ricco-deutscher.bio:
Dr. Ricco Deutscher is a German technology executive, entrepreneur, and physicist with a track record of building and scaling software companies in the European B2B software economy. He is best known as the founder and former CEO of billwerk, a leading platform for subscription management, billing, and payments in Europe.  ￼

Deutscher began his career as a software architect at SAP before moving into strategy consulting at McKinsey, where he developed a strong foundation in enterprise technology and business transformation. He went on to found multiple companies, including Sopera GmbH contributing to the growth of open-source and middleware ecosystems in Europe.  ￼

With a PhD in theoretical physics and academic experience across Leipzig, Moscow, and Hanover, Deutscher combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership.
exp: Sovereign wealth fund strategies and priorities
Public–private partnership structures in MEA
Capital deployment frameworks in emerging MEA markets
Investment authority relationship management
Cross-border deal structuring and advisory
dr-ricco-deutscher.bg: This advisory role draws on deep institutional relationships built over years of engagement with MEA's principal investment authorities. Members benefit from a trusted channel to sovereign capital conversations.

philip-hoelzer.bio: Our MEA legal advisor provides members with on-the-ground expertise in the regulatory, compliance, and licensing frameworks that govern industrial operations across the region. From free zone structures to bilateral investment treaties.
exp: Free zone structures and incorporation strategies
Bilateral investment treaty frameworks
Regulatory compliance and licensing across MEA
Contract law across key MEA jurisdictions

philip-hoelzer.bg: Practising across multiple MEA jurisdictions, our legal advisor has advised on market entry, JV formation, and large-scale procurement engagements.

eco.bio: Our economic analyst delivers proprietary research on sectoral underrepresentation, supply-demand imbalances, and structural investment opportunities across MEA markets — the analytical engine powering the Club's intelligence offering.

Market entry feasibility and opportunity mapping
Competitive landscape assessments by jurisdiction
Tender pipeline intelligence and prioritisation
Trade flow and logistics infrastructure analysis
eco.bg: Our economic analyst ensures that Club members receive intelligence that goes beyond publicly available data — identifying asymmetries only visible to those with deep regional knowledge.
